name: Stripe
about: Stripe builds the payments, billing and treasury rails that millions of businesses run on. Teams here work close to the money movement itself — latency, correctness and clarity all matter more than they do almost anywhere else.
perks: Health, dental and vision from day one

name: Supabase
about: Supabase wraps Postgres in the tooling most teams end up building themselves — auth, storage, realtime, edge functions. Everything ships in the open, so your commit history is your portfolio.

name: Linear
about: Linear is a small team with an unusually high bar for craft. Keyboard-first, sub-100ms everywhere, and opinionated about how software teams should plan work.

name: Figma
about: Figma put a multiplayer design tool inside a browser tab and changed how product teams work. The hard problems here are rendering, CRDTs and interaction design, usually all at once.

name: Vercel
about: Vercel runs the deployment platform behind Next.js and a large share of the modern web. Work spans edge networking, build systems and developer experience.

name: Retool
about: Retool gives engineering teams a way to stop hand-rolling admin panels. Customers are technical, feedback is direct, and shipping cycles are short.

name: GitHub
about: GitHub hosts the source of most of what runs on the internet, and now the AI tooling built on top of it. Scale is the constant: every system here has a very large number in front of it.

name: OpenAI
about: Research and the product built on top of it sit in the same building. Infrastructure work here is measured in tokens per second and in how many people the system stays up for.

name: Cloudflare
about: Cloudflare runs a network that sits in front of a meaningful fraction of web traffic. Security, performance and edge compute problems arrive at a scale that makes them genuinely novel.

name: Notion
about: Notion is a document, a database and an app platform wearing the same interface. The design and engineering challenges are about making enormous flexibility feel simple.

name: Ramp
about: Ramp builds spend management for finance teams, with a product that is measured on how much customer money it saves. Ledgers, controls and reporting, built to be genuinely pleasant.
perks: One month sabbatical at four years
Health cover for you and dependents

name: Datadog
about: Datadog ingests metrics, traces and logs from a very large number of machines and makes them queryable in seconds. Storage engines, time series and visualisation all in one product.
